scope: UW HUB map, durable messaging and iOS call heartbeat reliability
fixes: Prioritize a current device GPS fix for map focus and Locate; keep actual reported coordinates, uncertainty and freshness.
Request High GPS accuracy with existing bounded timeout and no location prerequisite for sending SOS.
Keep bundled UW streets for HUB request details when a saved offline map covers elsewhere.
Base missing-streets warning on the visible map center, not distant offscreen reports.
Release inbound durable processing from stalled outbound presence/location/message writes; coalesce presence responses.
Rotate retry attempts so older unacknowledged packets do not indefinitely starve later messages and receipts.
Schedule native call heartbeat in common run-loop modes so touch tracking does not pause muted-call keepalives.
